name: First Kiss at a Spooky Soiree
source:
FIRST KISS AT A SPOOKY SOIREE is a visual novel created for Yuri Jam 2016. you play as marzipan, a light witch who's gone her whole life without kissing anyone--UNTIL TONIGHT!

[From [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/first-kiss-at-a-spooky-soiree]official site[/url]]
translation:
《First Kiss at a Spooky Soiree》是为Yuri Jam 2016制作的视觉小说。你将扮演光之女巫marzipan：她这辈子从未与任何人接过吻——直到今晚！

（来源：[url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/first-kiss-at-a-spooky-soiree]官方网站[/url]）
